# 🦞 Lobster Library

> The nano Solana financial trading, deep research, ML prediction market & agentic vision AI agent library

## Docs

- [README](https://x402.wtf/library)
- [API Reference](https://x402.wtf/library/schema/speraxAgentSchema_v1.json)
- [Contributing](https://x402.wtf/library/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Agent Index](https://x402.wtf/library/index.json)

## Live API (x402.wtf/library)

- Index: <https://x402.wtf/library/index.json>
- Meta: <https://x402.wtf/library/meta.json>
- Schema: <https://x402.wtf/library/schema/speraxAgentSchema_v1.json>
- Individual agent: <https://x402.wtf/library/{agent-id}.json>
- Landing page: <https://x402.wtf/library/>

## npm Packages

- `@openclawd/lobster-library` — JSON catalog + schema (this package)
- `agentwallet-vault` — encrypted Solana + EVM keypair vault with REST API (`agentwallet serve`)
